claims.claim: B is a customer at a Foreign Currency Deposits Counter seeking deposit-related services

evidence.quote: Foreign Currency Deposits Counter , yes . What can I do for you ?

claims.claim: B inquired about available savings or deposit options

evidence.quote: OK . We offer 2 types of saving systems , Time Savings and Demand Savings .

claims.claim: B asked about the difference between demand deposit and time deposit interest rates

evidence.quote: There's quite a large difference . I mean , if you were to use demand deposit we could give you 0.13 % interest , but for a time deposit , of say , 1 year we would offer 0.82 % .
